ActivityOutput.description: New output lines of a running activity (e.g. a remote job's log), at most about one event per second.
ActivityOutput.title: ActivityOutput

ActivityStarted.description: Long-running work began (e.g. an app is running).
ActivityStarted.title: ActivityStarted

AnswerBody.description: An answer to an open prompt.

client.description: Who answers; recorded in the prompt's close event.
client.title: Client

value.description: The answer, as described by the prompt's answer schema.
value.title: Value

AnswerBody.title: AnswerBody

ArtifactExported.description: A step saved a file; ``path`` is relative to the run's ``artifacts/`` folder.
ArtifactExported.title: ArtifactExported

BranchEnded.description:
A branch of a step ended: done, failed (``error``), cancelled (stopped with the others), or skipped (the user
continued without it after it failed).
BranchEnded.title: BranchEnded

BranchStarted.description: A branch of a step started (see [`concurrently`][clabe.workflow.concurrently]); ``attempt`` counts its retries.
BranchStarted.title: BranchStarted

ClosingState.description: The closing screen of a finished run (see [`Run.begin_closing`][clabe.workflow.Run.begin_closing]).
ClosingState.title: ClosingState

CommandFinished.description:
A command an app ran (Bonsai, Open Ephys, a script) ended: what exactly ran, for provenance.

``files`` maps each existing file the command named (its arguments, its inputs, ``Bonsai.config`` next to the
program) to its SHA-256 (``None`` when too large to hash). Files of a remote command are hashed here, where the
run is (the remote checkout is the same commit when ``RemoteRepository.verify()`` passed).
CommandFinished.title: CommandFinished

CommandResult.description: Outcome of an answer or a command: accepted, or rejected with a reason to show the user.
CommandResult.title: CommandResult

DirEntry.description: One entry of a listed directory.
DirEntry.title: DirEntry

Header.description: A prominent header for the user.
Header.title: Header

ListDirBody.description: Lists a directory of the machine running the run (the remote path picker).

extensions.description: Only list files with these suffixes.
extensions.title: Extensions

path.description: Directory to list; the working directory when omitted.
path.title: Path

ListDirBody.title: ListDirBody

Notify.description: A message for the user. ``level`` is a [`MessageLevel`][clabe.ui.MessageLevel] value.
Notify.title: Notify

PromptClosed.description:
A prompt was answered (by ``answered_by``) or cancelled.

``answer`` is the JSON form of the accepted answer (secrets stay masked); ``None`` when cancelled.
PromptClosed.title: PromptClosed

PromptOpened.description:
A step is waiting for an answer. ``answer_schema`` is the JSON Schema of a valid answer.

When the same prompt was answered before (an earlier attempt of its step asked it; see
[`Run.forward`][clabe.workflow.Run.forward]), ``can_forward`` is set and ``previous_answer`` is that answer, in
its JSON form: clients prefill it and offer Forward. Secret answers are never remembered.
PromptOpened.title: PromptOpened

RecordResolved.description:
A step took a record (a rig, a trainer state, ...) from a store: which one, from where, and its content hash.

The record itself is saved as an artifact of the step (``stores/<kind>.json``), so the session keeps exactly what
it used even if the store changes later.
RecordResolved.title: RecordResolved

ReportBody.description: Reports an issue with the run (saved on this machine for the hub to collect).

client.description: Who reports; recorded as the report's ``reported_from``.
client.title: Client

comment.description: What went wrong, in the user's words.
comment.title: Comment

ReportBody.title: ReportBody

ReportInfo.description: What a report is about: who, where, when, and the user's comment. Stored as ``report.json`` in its zip.

reported_from.description: The client the report was made from
reported_from.title: Reported From

step.description: The step the run was on
step.title: Step

ReportInfo.title: ReportInfo

RunAgentInput.description: What an AG-UI client sends (only the fields clabe uses are read).
RunAgentInput.title: RunAgentInput

RunClosed.description:
The session was closed: by a client (``closed_by``), by the deadline (``"timeout"``) or by the launcher.

The last event of a run whose session was kept open (see [`Run.keep_open`][clabe.workflow.Run.keep_open]).
RunClosed.title: RunClosed

RunClosing.description:
The run has finished and the launcher shows its closing screen, waiting for a client to close the session.

``deadline`` is when it closes on its own (``None``: it waits for a client). See
[`Run.close`][clabe.workflow.Run.close].
RunClosing.title: RunClosing

RunState.description:
Snapshot of a run, for clients attaching mid-run. Follow events after ``last_seq``.

``back_target`` is the step [`Run.back`][clabe.workflow.Run.back] would go back to (``None``: Back is not
available). ``closing`` is set once the finished run shows its closing screen.
RunState.title: RunState

RunStatus.description: Where a run is in its lifecycle.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

ServerInfo.description: Identity of the server and the run it serves.
ServerInfo.title: ServerInfo

SessionInfo.description: What a run is about, as far as known so far: the hub lists it as a session.

reason.description: Why it ended, when it did not complete
reason.title: Reason

waiting.description: Whether a prompt waits for an answer
waiting.title: Waiting

SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

StepFailed.description: A step raised. ``warn_only`` steps continue; others pause the run.
StepFailed.title: StepFailed

StepFinished.description:
A step completed.

``summary`` is a truncated rendering of its output, ``output_sha256`` links to its line in ``outputs.jsonl``
and ``inputs`` gives the attempt of each upstream step whose output it consumed (``0``: skipped). The attempt of
a ``warn``-only failure (whose output is ``None``) has a ``StepFailed`` event and no line in ``outputs.jsonl``.
``output_sha256`` is ``None`` when the output was omitted or the run keeps no records.
StepFinished.title: StepFinished

StepSkipped.description: A step was skipped: an optional step declined, or a conditional step whose condition did not hold.
StepSkipped.title: StepSkipped

StepStarted.description: A step began running (``attempt`` counts runs of this step, from 1).
StepStarted.title: StepStarted

StepState.description: Snapshot of one step, for clients.
StepState.title: StepState

StepStatus.description: Where a step is in its lifecycle.
StepStatus.title: StepStatus

StepsInvalidated.description: Completed steps were reset to pending by going back.
StepsInvalidated.title: StepsInvalidated

info.description: Observe and drive a clabe run: a snapshot, a resumable event stream, answers and commands.
info.title: clabe run API
